Real, live-found gap named 2026-09-20 in NORTHSTAR §11 item 1: server_tick_witness only ever escalated witness_state, never de-escalated -- a hunt could only end via The Men arriving. core/sim.c's own sim_eliminate (resolved=2) already modeled the missing resolution path in the offline scenario harness, never wired live. New second pass in server_tick_witness resolves any SILENCING/ENGAGE human back to UNAWARE the moment no witnessable zombie remains in range (mood decay, moved away, or despawned). 6/6 live scratch-harness assertions, bazel 36/36 green, real server+client builds clean, ASan/UBSan clean. BIG_O/NORTHSTAR.md §21, closes §11 item 1.

⚓ ☃
title: LOS-loss/elimination resolution -- hunts finally end on their own
